input.title: Lauburu Belt-Ranked Competition Rashguard
input.descriptionHtml:
Lauburu Belt-Ranked Competition Rashguard

Design Architecture: Option B (Belt-Rank Coloured Emblems & Flank Accents)

Engineered for elite submission grapplers, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu competitors, and intense no-gi training. Developed directly from digitized tournament pattern blocks of the Absolute MMA competition standard (Parcel EJ350397089AU) with anatomical muscle compression sculpting.

  • Fabric Density & Touch: Heavyweight 250 GSM competition-grade poly-spandex (82% Polyester / 18% Spandex) featuring true 4-way omnidirectional stretch, ultra-high tensile recovery, and a low-glare matte athletic finish.
  • Tournament Proven Fit: Contoured raglan sleeve construction terminating at mid-bicep to eliminate armpit bunching; engineered curved drop-tail posterior hem (+2.0 cm) ensures complete lower back coverage during deep guard inversions.
  • Anti-Ride Silicone Hem: Continuous 25mm medical-grade silicone micro-ribbed elastic band heat-fused inside the bottom circumference to lock the rashguard securely over fight shorts.
  • Zero-Chafe Seam Architecture: Low-profile 1.2 cm crew neckband lined with soft 10mm herringbone reinforcement tape; heavy-duty 4-needle 6-thread flatlock stitching in 100% tone-on-tone stealth black (#141414) thread.
  • IBJJF Rulebook Compliance: 100% legal for official IBJJF No-Gi championship competition under Article 8.1.3, featuring rank-specific dyed sternum insignia and continuous underarm flank panels providing over 10% belt rank color surface area.

Note: Product status is currently locked in DRAFT mode pending final physical mat testing and wash validation of the initial prototype production run.

physical_sample_gate_invariants.shaoxing_facility_status: Reference garments delivered; 1:1 Absolute MMA recreation confirmed workable by Hicham Amrani

mandatory_testing_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Verify 250 GSM thickness, true 82/18 Poly-Spandex feel, +2.0 cm lumbar drop tail, and 25mm silicone inner elastic band
5 intensive live rolling rounds (minimum 6 minutes each) in full guard, half guard, and wrestling scrambles. Verify zero silicone waistband ride-up
5 consecutive 40°C machine wash cycles with standard detergent. Verify zero seam fraying, zero print fading (Grade 4.5+), and >= 98% tensile elastic recovery
